case_title: TANOTO ARIFIN VS CHAN DAVID AKA CHAN FONG KWAI

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $2,500.00 FILED BY TANOTO ARIFIN AS TO DEFENDANT CHAN DAVID AKA CHAN FONG KWAI ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR FEB-13-1991 AT 01:30 PM IN DEPT 04

PARTIES WAIVE SERVICE ON PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM. THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF TANOTO ARIFIN RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT CHAN DAVID AKA CHAN FONG KWAI $2,500.00 PRINCIPAL, $28.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $2,528.00 STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
